vocabulary.example: I work at a small company.
What do you do for a living?

grammar.explanation_en: When saying someone's job, use 'a' or 'an' before the job name: 'I am a teacher', 'She is an engineer' (use 'an' before a vowel sound). With he/she/it in the present tense, add '-s' to the verb: 'She works at a hospital.'
grammar.explanation_ko: 직업을 말할 때는 직업명 앞에 'a' 또는 'an'을 씁니다: 'I am a teacher', 'She is an engineer'(모음 소리 앞에는 an). he/she/it이 주어인 현재시제에서는 동사에 '-s'를 붙입니다: 'She works at a hospital.'

examples.en: My father works at a company.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, it is, but I like helping people.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 맞아요. 하지만 사람들을 돕는 게 좋아요.

reading.title: My Job
reading.text: I am a teacher. I work at a school near my house. Every day, I teach English to young students. My job is busy, but I enjoy it. My sister works as an engineer at a big company.
reading.text_ko: 저는 교사예요. 집 근처 학교에서 일해요. 매일 어린 학생들에게 영어를 가르쳐요. 제 일은 바쁘지만 즐겨요. 제 여동생은 큰 회사에서 엔지니어로 일해요.

explanation.en: The text says 'I am a teacher.'
The text says 'I teach English to young students.'
The text says 'My sister works as an engineer.'
